title: Being ind-quasi-affine is fpqc local on the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The property for a morphism of being ind-quasi-affine satisfies fpqc descent on the base. The retained proof is complete: base-change stability (lemma-base-change-ind-quasi-affine) gives one direction; for the descent direction one works Zariski locally on an affine base via the alternative characterization (lemma-ind-quasi-affine-alternative-definition), refines the fpqc covering to a single affine faithfully flat map g : Y' -> Y, and checks for every quasi-compact open U of X that U -> Y is quasi-affine exactly when U x_Y Y' -> Y' is, by the Descent chapter theorem that quasi-affineness is a descending fpqc property (Descent, lemma-descending-property-quasi-affine); quasi-compactness of base changes of quasi-compact opens is noted. Retained author proof at lines 19659-19678.
